description: Speech recognition in 50+ languages that also tells voices apart (S01, S02 …), for recordings up to 90 minutes. It times blocks of text (a sentence or a turn), not words: for close word times give the speaker an aligner. Experimental.
cpuNote: Several times slower than on a GPU.

settings.label: Hotwords
settings.description: Names and unusual words the audio contains, separated by commas: "Marcus, Ravenhollow". The model leans towards spelling them this way.
